sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Laser Micro-Machining of Bioresorbable Vascular Polymer Stents

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: Republic of the Marshall Islands (Aolepān Aorōkin Ṃajeḷ)
meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (RMI) — non-resident Business Corporation (BC) regime
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: Anglo-American common-law statutory system; the Business Corporations Act is modeled on and cross-referenced to the Delaware General Corporation Law (DGCL), overlain by Marshallese constitutional, customary, and regulatory law
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States–Marshall Islands Compact of Free Association (1986, amended 2003) — economic provisions and investor protections for U.S. nationals; not a BIT and does not create ISDS
No bilateral investment treaty or comprehensive double taxation agreement currently in force for the RMI

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2012 (RMI), as amended, and supporting FIU directives; Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organized Crime Act 2005, as amended; Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended (27 MIRC ch. 1), ss. 8–9 (corporate name and reservation), s. 65 (registered agent and registered office) and related Registrar of Corporations rules; the RMI has no public UBO register — UBO data is collected by licensed registered agents and disclosed to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit and Registrar on demand.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (RMI competent legalization authority) OR consular legalization by destination-state mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Existence
UBO Declaration and CDD attestation (beneficial ownership certificate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized attestation by registered agent; apostille/consular legalization only if filed in a foreign registry
Notarized attestation; apostille/consular legalization on bank instruction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized identity and address documents for each UBO, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the document's state of origin (e.g., PRC notary office)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Origin-state notarization; PRC MFA authentication; RMI Embassy consular legalization (mainland China is not an apostille state); Hague Apostille if the origin state is an apostille contracting party

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based CDD under the RMI AML/CTF Act 2012: (i) identify and verify each customer and every beneficial owner at the 25% ownership/control threshold, with 'senior managing official' fallback; (ii) screen all parties against UN Security Council consolidated sanctions domesticated by the Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organized Crime Act 2005; (iii) apply enhanced due diligence to politically exposed persons (foreign PEPs, family, close associates) and to high-risk jurisdictions; (iv) file suspicious transaction reports with the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit; (v) retain CDD/UBO records for at least five years after business relationship termination; (vi) for a Class III MedTech manufacturing entity operating via LC/SWIFT rails, market-standard OFAC/EU consolidated list screening is additionally required by the banking chain.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Registrar of Corporations (Republic of the Marshall Islands) — statutory corporate registry portal (online name search and e-filing; official registry portal: registerrmi.com)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Latin/Roman alphabetic characters; non-Latin (including Marshallese, Chinese, Cyrillic) names must be transliterated into Roman script for registration; names may include numerals and permitted corporate identifiers (Corporation/Corp., Incorporated/Inc., Company/Co., Limited/Ltd.); the name must be distinguishable from all active, reserved, and registered names and must not be deceptively similar; obscene, governmental, or impermissible-purpose words are rejected.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (BCCA), Title 27 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, principally Sections 27.101–27.121 (name, registered agent, and filing of Articles of Incorporation), Sections 27.301–27.361 (registered office and agent duties), and Sections 27.501–27.521 (directors and officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro Atoll; all filings are effected exclusively through a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BCA-1), executed by the incorporator before a notary public and submitted to the Registrar of Corporations together with the initial directors' consents and the registered agent's certificate of acceptance.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed on a Marshall Islands Business Corporation, and no escrow or capital deposit account is required. The Articles must authorize at least one class of shares; capital may be paid in cash, property, or services at a value fixed by the Board. In this formation the Board issues 500,000 common shares at US$0.0001 par value per share for aggregate consideration of US$100,000, declared fully paid and non-assessable.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Board of Directors hereby: (1) ratifies the subscription agreement and issues 500,000 common shares, par value $0.0001 per share, to the initial subscriber for aggregate consideration of $100,000, declared fully paid and non-assessable; (2) approves assignment of the Corporation's registered office to its licensed registered agent in Majuro, Marshall Islands, accepting the agent's consent and adopting such address for service of process; and (3) appoints the Corporation's President, Secretary, and Treasurer as Chief Executive Officer, Corporate Secretary, and Chief Financial Officer, respectively, effective immediately. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the Secretary is directed to execute statutory filings and pay applicable registry fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Licensed Registered Agent and KYC/AML Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent authorized under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act, supervised by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appoint a registered agent licensed in the Republic of the Marshall Islands. Deliver the corporate profile including name options, authorized share capital, intended directors and shareholders, and the ISIC 3250 manufacturing purpose. The agent conducts KYC and AML due diligence, prepares the constitutional draft documents, and obtains the registered agent's written consent to accept service of process. Execute the engagement letter and a limited power of attorney authorizing the agent to file.
required_dossiers: Corporate ownership chart and certificate of good standing of any ultimate parent
Certified passport copies of each proposed director and shareholder
Bank reference letter and source-of-funds declaration for the initial subscriber
Signed registered agent engagement letter
AML/KYC questionnaire completed by each beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent's compliance team issues a deficiency query, supply the requested enhanced due diligence materials, such as notarized ownership evidence or banking records, within 5 business days. The hold is limited to the deficient item and does not suspend preparation of other formation documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name availability search against the domestic and international corporate registry databases. File an optional name reservation memorandum to secure the proposed corporate name for 30 days. Confirm that the name ends with an accepted corporate designator such as Corporation, Incorporated, or Ltd., and does not conflict with a protected mark or an existing registered entity.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Name search request listing the proposed name and two alternates
Proof of payment of the name reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity, prohibited character, or public confusion, the applicant may select an alternate name from the reservation queue or submit a written consent letter from the owner of the conflicting name. Re-filing within 10 business days preserves the original priority date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Filing of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; filing transmitted electronically through the appointed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Articles of Incorporation in counterparts before a notary public. The incorporator or registered agent submits Form BCA-1 together with the initial directors' consents and the registered agent's certificate of acceptance, and pays the statutory incorporation fee. The Registrar assigns the corporate file number and date-stamps the instrument upon acceptance.
required_dossiers: Executed and notarized Articles of Incorporation (Form BCA-1)
Consent of initial directors, each signed and dated
Registered agent's certificate of acceptance
Authorized share capital schedule and par value statement
Government filing fee payment receipt
Power of attorney authorizing the registered agent to file
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a deficiency memorandum, the registered agent amends the flagged clauses and re-submits within 10 business days. A cure notice does not vitiate the original filing priority where the original submission was complete except for the flagged item; a corrective addendum may be attached to the original instrument.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Commencement of Corporate Existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon validation of the Articles and full settlement of official fees, the Registrar endorses the filing and issues the Certificate of Incorporation, which conclusively evidences formation and the start of separate legal personality. The registered agent retrieves the certified certificate, opens the corporate minute book, and records the corporate number and date of incorporation in the statutory register.
required_dossiers: Date-stamped copy of the accepted Articles of Incorporation
Receipt of incorporation fee payment
Registered agent retrieval authorization letter
Request for certified copy and optional certificate of incumbency or apostille
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains a material typographical error in the corporate name, number, or date, file a Certificate of Correction within 5 business days. The correction is retroactive to the original formation date and is reissued under the same corporate number.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, Adoption of Bylaws, and First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Business Corporation, with procedures supervised by the Corporate Secretary and the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the organizational meeting of the board, or act by unanimous written consent in lieu of a meeting. Adopt the corporate Bylaws, approve the First Board Resolution covering share issuance, registered office designation, and officer appointments, and execute officer acceptance letters. Record the resolutions in the minute book and prepare the share certificates and directors' and officers' register.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution or unanimous written consent of directors
Corporate Bylaws approved and filed in the minute book
Share subscription agreement and share certificate stubs
Registered office designation and service-of-process acceptance records
Officer acceptance letters for Chief Executive Officer, Corporate Secretary, and Chief Financial Officer
Directors' and officers' register
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a quorum or consent signature is defective, circulate a corrective unanimous written consent executed by all directors within 10 business days. The corrective instrument recites the original resolution date and is ratified by unanimous written approval to maintain continuity of board action.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Business License Registration for Non-Resident Manufacturing Entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Foreign Investment Board (FIB), Republic of the Marshall Islands, established under the Foreign Investment Business Act 2018
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Because the entity is a non-resident business corporation conducting Class III medical device manufacturing, register the foreign investment and obtain the Foreign Investment Business License before commencing physical operations. Submit the FIBA application together with the certified Certificate of Incorporation, a recent Certificate of Good Standing, the project description for laser micro-machining of bioresorbable polymer stents, and the designated physical facility address or authorized operational-site arrangement.
required_dossiers: FIBA application Form 1 for a Foreign Investment Business License
Certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation
Certificate of Good Standing issued within 30 days
Notarized power of attorney for the local representative
Detailed manufacturing project description for ISIC 3250 operations
Physical facility description, lay-out plan, and laser equipment list
Clean criminal record certificates for controlling shareholders and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Foreign Investment Board requests supplemental information or further public consultation, the applicant must cure within 14 days by filing a responding memorandum. The FIBA License, once granted, is valid for up to one year and renewable upon submission of the annual report. Operations may not commence until the license is issued.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Foreign Investment Board (FIB) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, Ministry of Finance, in coordination with the Ministry of Health and Human Services for Class III medical device manufacturing oversight
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) with manufacturing endorsement for Class III medical device production (ISIC 3250 - Laser Micro-Machining of Bioresorbable Vascular Polymer Stents)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full EIA Report (Category 1 - Prescribed Manufacturing Activity). The proposed laser micro-machining and solvent-based surface treatment of bioresorbable polymer stents constitute a prescribed industrial activity under the RMI Environmental Protection Act, requiring a Full Environmental Impact Assessment with public comment and EPA permit conditions.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: pH 6.0-9.0; Biological Oxygen Demand (BOD5) not exceeding 30 mg/L; Total Suspended Solids not exceeding 50 mg/L; oil and grease not exceeding 15 mg/L; no free cyanide or halogenated solvent discharges. Air emissions: particulate matter not exceeding 50 mg/Nm3; volatile organic compounds routed to a thermal oxidizer achieving at least 98% destruction removal efficiency; HEPA filtration for laser ablation particulate. Hazardous waste: polymer residues, isopropyl alcohol, and methanol waste streams manifested under RMI EPA waste tracking and exported only to an authorized treatment facility.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Compliance Certificate issued by the RMI Fire Safety Division following inspection of fire suppression systems, hazardous material segregation, and egress routes; Structural Load Inspection Certificate prepared by a registered professional engineer certifying floor loads for laser and cleanroom equipment; and Occupational Health and Safety clearance under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 2007 issued by the RMI Occupational Health Office, covering machine guarding, Class 4 laser interlocks, ventilation, and personal protective equipment programs.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Office (RTO), Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; corporate registry and Certificate of Good Standing: Registrar of Corporations, Association of the Marshall Islands Companies (AMIC) portal
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The RMI issues no general statutory TIN to non-resident Business Corporations. The operative identifier is the corporate registration number and Certificate of Good Standing issued by the Registrar of Corporations under the Business Corporations Act 1990, procured by filing Articles of Incorporation (domestic non-resident designation), paying the registration fee, and designating a qualified registered agent in the RMI. If the entity maintains RMI payroll, it must separately register with the RTO as an employer for Wages and Salaries Tax and Social Security purposes and obtain an employer/taxpayer account number. No VAT ID exists or is obtainable because the RMI imposes no VAT, GST, or sales tax. A pure non-resident BC with no RMI-source income has no periodic income tax filing obligation and must only maintain the annual franchise fee/registration and registered agent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (non-resident domestic corporation exemption under the Business Corporations Act; RMI-source income remains taxable under the Income Tax Act 1989 within the territorial scope)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists under RMI law. Statutory status mechanisms available: (i) incorporation as a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation under the BCA to secure exemption from RMI income tax and all other RMI taxes on non-RMI-source income; (ii) continuation/domestication of a foreign corporation into a non-resident domestic corporation; (iii) election to cancel non-resident status by filing a resident-domestic designation, which subjects the entity to RMI-source taxation; (iv) no hybrid mismatch, fiscal unity, or qualified intermediary elections are recognized by the RTO.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (no VAT, GST, or sales and use tax; the sole indirect fiscal levy is customs import duty under the Customs Tariff Act 1990, imposed exclusively on physical imports into the RMI, with no equivalent tax on exports or services)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no turnover threshold triggers any RMI indirect tax registration. Import duty liability arises per consignment on the customs value of goods entering the RMI; HS 9021 (intra-arterial stents) are generally duty-exempt or subject to minimal tariff under the prevailing schedule. Exports are entirely outside any indirect tax base, and no export duty or VAT registration threshold exists.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None — the RMI mandates no real-time fiscal clearance, SAF-T/XML e-invoicing, QR/digital stamping, or API-based invoice validation. Border declarations are processed through the customs administration (ASYCUDA-based entry lodgement), which requires only standard commercial documentation (customs entry, commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading/air waybill) with no statutory invoice clearance protocol.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — since the RMI imposes no VAT/GST, there is no 0% export rate to claim and no input VAT credit or refund mechanism. Exports of coronary drug-eluting stents from the RMI fall outside the RMI indirect tax base entirely. Compliance substitutes: (i) RMI Customs export entry for trade statistics; (ii) health-sector export/manufacturing authorization for Class III medical devices under RMI health and sanitation regulations; (iii) banking AML/KYC documentation under SWIFT wire and Letter of Credit rails; (iv) no requirement to substantiate export zero-rating to the RTO because no RTO indirect tax filing exists.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: RMI Customs Export Declaration/Entry (export statistics form)
Bill of Lading (ocean) or Air Waybill (air)
Class III medical device export/manufacturing authorization (RMI Health and Sanitation regulations)
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 or Letter of Credit documentation (bank compliance record)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No export VAT zero-rating or clawback regime exists because the RMI imposes no indirect tax on exports. Exposure arises if the entity is re-characterized as earning RMI-source income (e.g., RMI payroll, RMI warehousing, RMI domestic sales), enabling the Revenue and Taxation Office to assess income tax under the Income Tax Act 1989 at statutory rates, plus interest and late-payment penalties, subject to a 3-year assessment limitation period absent fraud. Customs false-declaration penalties (fines and forfeiture) attach under the Customs Tariff Act 1990 for inaccurate export entries. Anti-money-laundering penalties under the Crimes Act and RMI AML regulations may attach to incomplete beneficial ownership or payment-rail documentation on LC/SWIFT transactions, including corporate fines, director disqualification, and suspension of the entity's registered status for filings made in bad faith.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Division of Financial Institutions, Republic of the Marshall Islands Ministry of Finance; Republic of the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit; no domestic central bank exists and the U.S. Federal Reserve acts as de facto monetary authority through official dollarization
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The U.S. dollar is legal tender and the sole circulating currency, making both current account and capital account transactions fully convertible without domestic exchange controls. There are no restrictions on inward capital, outward profit remittances, dividend distributions, or repatriation of capital, provided that the underlying transactions are legitimate and supported by audited financial statements, beneficial ownership declarations, and tax residency certificates. The practical hurdle is not convertibility but anti-money-laundering compliance and correspondent bank due diligence, especially for non-resident Business Corporations engaged in high-risk medtech manufacturing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. The Republic of the Marshall Islands imposes no statutory surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion timeline, and no minimum conversion ratio for export receipts. Export proceeds may be retained, converted, or remitted in U.S. dollars without Central Bank approval; all such receipts must be reconciled with commercial invoices, bills of lading, and customs declarations solely for AML/KYC monitoring.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / USD Operational Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam – Marshall Islands Branch
Marshall Islands Development Bank (if non-concessional commercial treasury vehicle is accepted)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. The Republic of the Marshall Islands has no licensed fintech EMI framework for offshore digital banks; unlicensed financial intermediation is prohibited under the Banking Act and the Model Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism Act. A foreign EMI may be used only if it holds a valid banking or electronic money license in a reputable jurisdiction and establishes a flow-through U.S. dollar account via a correspondent bank; however, RMI-supervised banks generally view offshore EMIs as high-risk and will require enhanced due diligence, a legal opinion, and evidence of licensing and regulatory oversight before accepting routing or settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person presence is generally mandated for at least two authorized signatories or directors of a non-resident Business Corporation during final account opening at Bank of Marshall Islands and Bank of Guam. Remote opening is not standard and is only permitted on a bespoke exception basis with a recognized local registered agent, notarized board resolutions, apostilled corporate documents, and an interview via secure video call with a compliance officer; the final decision rests with each bank’s Money Laundering Compliance Officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident legal person with multi-tier holding structure in a tax-exempt zone
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of certificate of incorporation and articles; current beneficial ownership register; corporate organizational chart showing all shareholders up to natural persons; valid passports for all directors and ultimate beneficial owners; notarized board resolution resolving to open the account and designating authorized signatories; apostilled certificate of good standing; source-of-wealth statement signed by each ultimate beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Class III medical device manufacturing involving bioresorbable vascular stents and laser micro-machining
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Statutory manufacturing license; valid FDA 510(k) or CE marking certificate for coronary drug-eluting stents; ISO 13485 certificate; quality management system documentation; audited financial statements; major purchase orders and supply agreements; proof of physical manufacturing capability or binding contract manufacturing agreement with a qualified FDA-registered facility.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High initial capital injection from non-resident shareholders into Capital Escrow Account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statement of the remitting shareholder showing legitimate source of funds; tax clearance or tax reference certificate from the shareholder’s jurisdiction; source-of-funds breakdown; share subscription agreement; board resolution approving the capital contribution; private wealth or asset disposal documentation if funds originate from personal investments; independent forensic accounting report in the event of unusual funding complexity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital must be remitted in U.S. dollars by SWIFT MT103 or MT202 for larger interbank transfers, routed to the entity’s USD account held at Bank of Marshall Islands or Bank of Guam, with the latter clearing via U.S. correspondent banks through Fedwire or CHIPS. The wire must reference the entity ID, the share subscription agreement number, and the stated purpose code as 'Capital injection / equity contribution' to avoid misclassification. The capital escrow account must not be mixing trade funds; verification includes matching of remitter, beneficiary, share ledger, and source-of-wealth file, plus receipt of an audited statement of share capital.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements for medtech raw materials, sterilization services, and freight are executed via SWIFT MT103 for direct wire to suppliers, or via SWIFT MT700 documentary letter of credit for commercial import transactions. All outbound payments are cleared in USD through U.S. correspondent clearing rails, with mandatory OFAC/UN/EU sanctions screening and structured reference to the purchase order, pro forma invoice, LC terms, and bill of lading. For intercompany disbursements to contract manufacturers, the bank will require a copy of the executed service agreement, milestone certificate, and tax equivalence or withholding analysis to satisfy any Estonian or other jurisdiction’s WHT obligations if the beneficiary is in a treaty network.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/JPY outright forward contracts with Bank of Guam or other U.S. correspondent bank when settling Japanese-sourced polymer supply contracts
USD/EUR non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for German/Swiss equipment procurement hedging
USD/CNY NDF contracts for procurement of stent delivery system components from Chinese contract manufacturers
Cross-currency interest rate swaps only where a significant long-term USD-denominated liability is matched with a non-USD revenue stream
Plain-vanilla USD binary-free currency options with a regulated international bank for bi-annual raw-material purchasing cycles

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Report and Franchise Tax Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation; annual filing window opens 30 days prior and closes on the anniversary, with a permissible grace period of 30 days after the anniversary subject to penalty
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% per month or portion thereof, based on the annual report fee; continued delinquency for more than 90 days after service of notice may result in administrative dissolution or strike-off from the Register

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit for a non-resident Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act. A shareholder consent order or lender covenant requiring independently audited financial statements will trigger a voluntary audit. No public consolidation or audit filing is required.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No locally prescribed GAAP. Management accounts may be prepared under IFRS or US GAAP, as adopted by the Board for corporate record keeping and investor reporting. Statutory books must accurately reflect all transactions and be capable of producing reliable financial representations.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent must obtain an annual beneficial ownership declaration and confirm any share transfers under the Marshall Islands FIU regulations. No public UBO filing with the Registrar is made; the beneficial ownership register is physically maintained at the registered office and must be updated within 30 days of any transfer or change. The annual confirmation requires sign-off from a director that the registered beneficial ownership information is accurate.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% effective rate for a Non-Resident Business Corporation deriving no income from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands; statutory corporate rates of 3% on the first US$10 million of RMI-source taxable income and 5% on RMI-source taxable income exceeding US$10 million apply only to resident corporations or non-resident corporations with RMI-source income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Total statutory exemption of foreign-source income for non-resident domestic corporations under the Income Tax Act 1989; no capital gains tax; no VAT/GST; no gross receipts tax on export manufacturing revenue; no franchise or capital duty other than the US$75 annual Corporate Report fee; no withholding tax on outbound distributions, interest, or royalties. The sale of Class III coronary drug-eluting stents to foreign distributors is outside the RMI tax net provided no sales are consummated, no services performed, and no property situated within the Republic.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Marshall Islands Corporation Income Tax Return (Form RTA-CIT) filed via the Revenue and Taxation Administration (RTA) e-Services portal (revenue.gov.mh) or by paper submission to the RTA, Ministry of Finance, Majuro.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the 15th day of the fourth month following the close of the taxable year (i.e., April 15 for a calendar-year corporation); the RTA may grant a written extension of up to 6 months upon timely application.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Gross income from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate gross income derived from RMI sources, including sales of goods consummated inside the Republic, services performed in the Republic, and use of property located in the Republic.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter '0' or 'None.' Exclude all export revenue from coronary drug-eluting stents sold FOB to foreign distributors; exclude payments received outside the Republic through Swift wire or Letters of Credit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Deductions attributable to RMI-source income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ordinary and necessary expenses directly and reasonably allocable to the gross income reported in Box 1.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter '0' unless the company has allocable RMI costs. Do not allocate group overhead, laser micro-machining labor, or coating-technology royalties to a nil Box 1.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Excess of Box 1 over Box 2, computed under the Income Tax Act 1989.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter '0.' A non-resident tax-exempt corporation with no RMI activity has no taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Computed tax (3% up to US$10 million; 5% on excess)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax at the applicable statutory corporate rate applied to Box 3.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter '0' and attach the Exemption Schedule confirming non-resident status and the absence of any permanent establishment in the Republic.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Tax credits, prepayments, and withheld amounts
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for RMI tax withheld at source, prepayments, and other statutory credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter '0' unless an RMI payer withheld tax; no credit is available for foreign (e.g., US or EU) income taxes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Net tax payable or refund due
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Box 4 minus Box 5; amount due with the return or refund claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter '0' and file the nil return to preserve clean corporate standing and evidence of tax-exempt classification.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Schedule TP-1 - Transactions with related persons
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of intercompany transactions: purchases of bioresorbable polymer, drug-eluting coating licenses, management fees, and stent component supply contracts with affiliated entities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'Not applicable' if no RMI-source income is reportable; otherwise identify each related party, the amount, and the arm's-length method applied. Maintain supporting comparables in the event the RTA Secretary exercises reallocation authority.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: penalty of 5% per month or fraction of a month on the unpaid tax, capped at 25% of the tax due; late payment: monthly interest at the statutory rate; negligence: additional 20% of the tax deficiency; fraud: additional 50% of the tax deficiency; willful failure to file a return or willful tax evasion is a criminal offense punishable by a fine not exceeding US$10,000 and imprisonment for up to 3 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Report to the Registrar of Corporations (Business Corporations Act, Section 50) filed through the Registrar's online filing system (registered agent portal).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed during the period January 1 through March 31 of each calendar year, reporting as of the preceding December 31; the Registrar's fee is US$75 for a non-resident domestic corporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 1 - Corporate name and registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the Business Corporation and its Marshall Islands company registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the certified name as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; any trade name or brand (e.g., stent product line) must not be substituted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 2 - Registered agent and registered office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and street address of the licensed registered agent in the Republic; the registered office must be a physical location, not a post office box.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident company must maintain a registered agent authorized by the Registrar; failure to do so is grounds for administrative dissolution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of all directors and officers in office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The directors and officers may be natural persons of any nationality and need not reside in the Marshall Islands.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares, par value, and classes of stock issued and outstanding.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm no bearer shares are issued; bearer share instruments are prohibited or must be immobilized under the Business Corporations Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the corporation is a non-resident domestic corporation deriving no income from sources within the Republic.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mark 'Non-resident' to preserve the 0% income tax exemption; any change to resident status must be reported to the RTA immediately.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing is subject to escalating late fees per the Registrar's fee schedule; failure to file for two consecutive years results in administrative strike-off and revocation of the Certificate of Incorporation. Reinstatement is discretionary, requires court petition or Registrar consent, and payment of all arrears, penalties, and reinstatement fees.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the Marshall Islands Income Tax Act 1989 imposes no withholding tax on dividends, deemed dividends, or liquidating distributions paid by a Marshall Islands Business Corporation to non-resident shareholders. Dividends may be repatriated freely via Swift wire without RMI tax clearance.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Republic of the Marshall Islands has no comprehensive double taxation agreements; relief is statutory rather than treaty-based. Where a foreign payer (e.g., a US distributor) requires proof of exemption, the company must apply to the RTA for a Certificate of Tax Residence or Exemption Certificate confirming non-resident status and absence of RMI-source income; the certificate, together with a completed US Form W-8BEN-E or equivalent, must be submitted to the withholding agent. The RMI-US relationship is governed by the Compact of Free Association and Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs), which provide for administrative exchange of information but not withholding rate reductions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT: 0% on outbound royalties for patents, know-how, and drug-eluting coating technology; 0% on debt interest paid to non-resident lenders. Because no comprehensive DTA network exists, treaty-reduced rates are not applicable; the exemption is absolute under domestic law for non-resident recipients.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory Marshall Islands Local File, Master File, or Country-by-Country Reporting threshold in US dollars. The Income Tax Act 1989 empowers the Secretary of Finance to reallocate income, deductions, or credits between related persons if transactions are not conducted at arm's length. In practice, contemporaneous documentation is advisable only where the company derives RMI-source income; for multinational groups, OECD Country-by-Country Reporting thresholds (consolidated group revenue of EUR 750 million) apply in the ultimate parent jurisdiction, not in the Marshall Islands.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands Economic Substance Regulations 2019, enacted in response to EU Code of Conduct requirements, apply to entities carrying on 'relevant activities': banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, distribution and service centers, and intellectual property (IP) holding. Manufacturing of Class III coronary drug-eluting stents is not a listed relevant activity; however, if the Marshall Islands entity directly holds patents, trademarks, or regulatory data for the drug-eluting coating and derives income from licensing those assets, it may be classified as an IP holding company and must satisfy core income-generating activity tests. A non-resident entity that is tax resident in a foreign jurisdiction and supplies a Certificate of Tax Residence may claim exemption. All relevant entities must file an annual Economic Substance Declaration with the Registrar within 12 months of financial year-end, with up to US$10,000 in penalties for non-filing and continuing penalties for persistent non-compliance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willfully omitting income actually sourced to the Republic of the Marshall Islands, falsely claiming non-resident exemption while operating through an office, warehouse, or dependent agent in Majuro or Ebeye, or submitting falsified financial statements to the RTA to suppress RMI-source sales of stents to local hospitals or distributors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil fraud penalty of 50% of the tax deficiency, negligence penalty of 20%, monthly statutory interest on unpaid tax, criminal fine up to US$10,000, and imprisonment up to 3 years upon conviction; loss of the 0% exemption with retroactive assessment of the 3%/5% corporate rates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or cause the filing of a false or fraudulent return are jointly and severally liable for the civil penalties; criminal conviction of an officer results in imprisonment, and extradition may be sought under mutual legal assistance channels.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Abuse of Tax-Exempt Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the Business Corporation as a pure booking vehicle for global stent sales with no real management, no substance, no bank account in its own name, and no economic activity, while misrepresenting non-resident status solely to avoid taxation in the end-market jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic Substance Regulations penalties: US$10,000 for failure to file the annual declaration, additional US$10,000 for continuing non-compliance, revocation of Certificate of Good Standing, and automatic exchange of information with OECD/EU member states, exposing the group to coordinated tax investigations in the market countries.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A court may pierce the corporate veil and treat the company as an alter ego of its directors or parent, making directors personally liable for the group's unpaid foreign taxes and penalties; travel restrictions may be imposed through tax information exchange and mutual assistance proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring dividends or effecting share buybacks while the company is insolvent, or stripping the stent manufacturing entity of patent and regulatory assets to defeat creditor or product-liability claims arising from defective Class III devices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Business Corporations Act, directors who vote for or assent to an unlawful distribution are jointly and severally liable to the corporation for the full amount of the distribution, plus interest; fraudulent conveyance statutes allow avoidance of the transfer and recovery of the assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal restitution orders to repay unlawful dividends, disgorgement of profits, asset freezes, and court-ordered prohibitions on acting as directors or officers of any company registered in the Marshall Islands.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting settlement proceeds from sanctioned distributors, misrepresenting beneficiaries on Letters of Credit, structuring successive Swift wire transfers to evade banking AML controls, or using the stent export trade to layer proceeds of unlawful activity through the Marshall Islands entity designated as a High-Risk Special License holder.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Anti-Money Laundering Act 2011 (as amended): fine up to US$50,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years for money laundering; the Financial Intelligence Unit may freeze bank accounts; the special license may be suspended or revoked; enhanced due-diligence obligations apply to all payment rails, including Letters of Credit and Swift wires.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers with knowledge or reckless disregard of the laundering scheme face joint criminal liability, personal fines, imprisonment, travel bans, and extradition under the US Compact of Free Association framework.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Administrative Dissolution / Loss of Limited Liability
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the Annual Corporate Report with the Registrar for two consecutive years, failing to maintain a registered agent, or abandoning the registered office in the Republic without replacement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Registrar strikes the company off the register and revokes the Certificate of Incorporation; the corporation loses legal capacity to contract, sue, or defend; all privileges of the 0% tax regime lapse; reinstatement is discretionary and requires payment of all arrears, penalties, and a reinstatement fee.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: After dissolution, directors and officers are personally liable for all debts and contractual obligations incurred in the company's name; the statutory shield of limited liability is removed, and creditors may collect directly against personal assets.
